svg.title: Theorem status, T1 to T34
svg.desc: Grid of 34 entries, T1 to T34 with T9 shown as T9-L and T19 split into T19a and T19b, each with a coded level. Proved: T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T7, T8, T14, T15, T32, T33; Proved for a stated core or fragment; rest tested or cited: T6, T9-L, T13, T34; Proved on a small-step semantics of a core of RCE: T16, T17, T19a, T20, T23; Proved on a named model (rotation, statement, runs, session calculus): T11, T12, T24, T28; Model: T18, T19b, T21, T22, T25, T26, T31; Model, with evaluator vectors checked by the Lean kernel: T27, T29, T30; Checked mechanically (LALR(1) tables): T10.
svg.text: Level of each result as recorded in the specification (draft 0.7, rce ac95172). Lean 4 v4.12.0, no Mathlib.
totality of δ, explicit step bound
recursion and composition on separate models
ownership core; instrumented semantics of borrow paths
atomicity: a kept step leaves the state
program emitters agree with the evaluator

core fragment; implementation tested on every target
